text: Kan extensions generalise limits and colimits. The left Kan extension Lan_K F is characterised by:
choices: A natural transformation η: F ⇒ Lan_K F ∘ K that is universal
A right adjoint to restriction along K
A colimit formula (Lan_K F)(e) = colim_{(Ke'→e)} F(e')
explanation: Left Kan: both the adjoint characterisation and coend/colimit formula describe Lan_K F.
